assessments.reasoning: Authenticity follows from spdx_detail at spdx/license-list-data revision 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, json/details/CC0-1.0.json. Integrity follows from the four matching reported range digests. Relevance comes from the ID [16343,16366), name [16293,16340), deprecation flag [4,35) and seeAlso [16636,16718). Interpretation gives CC0-1.0, Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal, false for deprecation, and the publisher's /publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode URL. Applicability follows from spdx_data_tag targeting this exact data pin. The contradiction check found the identical ID, name and URL in spdx_xml [99,337) and the corresponding edition base in publisher_readme [4999,5294).

Authenticity follows from publisher_readme in Creative Commons' pinned legal-tools repository. Integrity follows from its matching [4999,5294) digest. Relevance comes from the canonical URL in that passage. Interpretation follows from the accompanying title, zero unit, 1.0 version and Universal jurisdiction designation. Applicability follows because the SPDX seeAlso URL appends legalcode to that exact edition base, and publisher_live serves the titled English legalcode.txt there. The contradiction check against publisher_pin [0,48) confirms the publisher's shorter edition title and resolves the different wording of the SPDX name. The README supplies publisher-side context only.

Authenticity follows from spdx_xml at spdx/license-list-XML revision b1dbeb5c8bca21af860a90e187f71d60b84a7a40, src/CC0-1.0.xml. Integrity follows from the matching [99,337) digest. Relevance comes from the license element and its crossRef child in that range. Interpretation gives licenseId CC0-1.0, name Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal and crossRef https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode. Applicability follows from the job's full checkout SHA and its generator reading src. The contradiction check against spdx_detail found exact agreement with licenseId, name and seeAlso at the separate data pin. The XML supplies upstream field lineage.

Authenticity follows from spdx_data_tag, the GitHub Git tag-object response for spdx/license-list-data object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b. Integrity follows from the matching whole-response [0,700) digest. Relevance comes from its tag, message and object fields. Interpretation follows from tag v3.29.0 directly targeting type commit, SHA 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, with the version 3.29.0 License List message. Applicability follows from this target equaling the spdx_detail URL revision. The contradiction check found that same full SHA in spdx_generation and the corresponding pushed prefix in spdx_release_job. The response reports an unsigned tag.

Authenticity follows from spdx_xml_tag, the GitHub Git tag-object response for spdx/license-list-XML object 7523cc3daa7149e35e2debd7466c1dcb14a84e19. Integrity follows from the matching whole-response [0,698) digest. Relevance comes from the tag name and its typed target. Interpretation follows from v3.29.0 directly targeting commit b1dbeb5c8bca21af860a90e187f71d60b84a7a40 and the message identifying License List version 3.29.0. Applicability follows from that target equaling the spdx_xml URL revision. The contradiction check found the same full SHA in the job's post-checkout output [12464,12534). This unsigned object supplies source-release context.

Authenticity follows from spdx_generation at the spdx/license-list-data Git commit API endpoint. Integrity follows from the matching [0,1237) whole-response digest and agreement of the URL and response SHA. Relevance comes from its message, SHA and parents fields. Interpretation follows from “License list build 3.29.0 using license list publisher 3.1.4”. Applicability follows from commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48 containing the pinned details file and being the data tag target. The contradiction check matched its sole parent 3027e0ce357ad6290902c4b57a677fc3b55051b9 and its own SHA to the old and new prefixes in the job's push, and matched its message to the job's actual commit output. The XML tag and job checkout identify the corresponding source revision.

Authenticity follows from spdx_release_job, the authenticated original GitHub Actions job-log endpoint for spdx/license-list-XML job 104892289184. Integrity follows from the tool's 81,691-byte body record, SHA-256 1e9137b29385a9ce0deaa48c20ab9927916426819a69f0cfc6281d239340c282, and six separately reported range digests matching the citations. The byte-range passages derive from that one log. Relevance follows from [10328,10526) fetching the XML SHA into refs/tags/v3.29.0 and [11093,11190) actually checking out that ref. Interpretation follows from the post-checkout git log command [12394,12464) returning b1dbeb5c8bca21af860a90e187f71d60b84a7a40 [12464,12534). Applicability follows from the subsequent generator invocation with src, the cleaned data checkout, release 3.29.0 and publisher 3.1.4, followed by the resulting commit [78070,78175) and push [78398,78461). The contradiction check matched the XML HEAD to spdx_xml_tag, the commit output '[main 31ba1a5]' and build message to spdx_generation, and '3027e0c..31ba1a5  main -> main' to its full parent and the spdx_data_tag target. These events establish deployment context for the pinned JSON.

limitations: This is a documentary crosswalk for SPDX 3.29.0. Text equivalence, copyright classification and grants for particular projects require different evidence.

The XML, generated JSON, tags, build commit and job record share the corresponding SPDX information lineage. Both annotated tags and the data commit are reported unsigned. Release attribution rests on repository records and their agreement.

The job records the build that produced the data revision. A complete bit-for-bit reproduction would require rerunning the build and comparing outputs. The JSON includes time-dependent cross-reference metadata.

The fixed tool reported an 81,691-byte original job body. The displayed output elided part of the middle. All six cited passages, the generator invocation and the push destination were visible. The middle elision limits any assessment of the entire log.
reasoning: At the tagged data commit, the generated JSON pairs CC0-1.0 with “Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal” and points to https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode. The tagged source XML contains the same ID, name and URL. Creative Commons independently identifies the edition at that URL's base. The deployment log connects the actual XML checkout to generation and publication of the data commit containing the inspected JSON.
